Class StreamSegment

  • java.lang.Object
    • hec.model.StreamSegment
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AsciiSerializable, FieldAccessor, StreamReferenceHolder, java.io.Serializable

    public class StreamSegment
extends java.lang.Object
implements AsciiSerializable, StreamReferenceHolder
    Simple container to identify a segment on a stream element either a station or a coordinate may be used to identify the ends of the segment
